title: The Woman Who Could Expose Kira Just Walked Up to Jack . . . (highlight)
caption:
In Death Note episode 6, Ray Penber's fiancée walks into police headquarters and ends up talking to Jack, the one man she should never trust. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #recap #animerewind

segments.say: The one woman who can expose Jack walks right up to him, and he *smiles*.
To see how it got here, go back to the moment Jack walks into police *headquarters*.
A woman at the front desk is begging for a *detective*.
She says she has information on Kira, and Ryuk starts to *grin*.
Jack's father runs the case, so Jack steps in and offers to pass on her *message*.
Then he gets smooth. He lends her his own phone, so she can talk to the chief *herself*.
Then they swap names.  She calls herself Shoko *Maki*.
Jack says Kira controls his victims. She agrees, and she goes *further*.
Kira can kill in other ways, she says, not only with heart *attacks*.
Jack freezes. How does this woman know so *much*?
Her fiancé was one of the twelve FBI agents who *died*.
Jack hears the name Ray Penber and hides his *shock*.
And she is only getting started. Even Ryuk's eyes go *wide*.
